description_en: Provides a multimodal detection API for AI security guardrails over the WebSocket protocol, offering comprehensive detection capabilities such as content compliance detection, sensitive content detection, prompt attack detection, malicious file detection, and malicious URL detection
description_zh: 支持websocket协议的AI安全护栏多模态检测接口，包括内容合规检测、敏感内容检测、提示词攻击检测、恶意文件检测、恶意URL检测等全方位检测能力
name: MultiModalGuardWs

parameters.help_en:
The moderation service category. Valid values:
query_security_check_pro: Pro edition of AI input content security detection.
response_security_check_pro: Pro edition of AI-generated content security detection.
img_query_security_check: AIGC input image security detection.
img_response_security_check: AIGC output image security detection.
text_img_mix_guard: Multimodal (text and image) hybrid security detection.
file_security_sync_check: AIGC input or output file security detection.
text_file_sec_sync_check: Multimodal (text and file) real-time security detection
parameters.help_zh:
审核服务分类，包括：

query_security_check_pro：AI输入内容安全检测_pro版
response_security_check_pro：AI生成内容安全检测_pro版
img_query_security_check：AIGC输入图片安全检测
img_response_security_check：AIGC输出图片安全检测
text_img_mix_guard：多模态（文本+图片）混合安全检测
file_security_sync_check：AIGC输入或输出文件安全检测
text_file_sec_sync_check：多模态（文本+文件）实时安全检测
parameters.name: service

parameters.help_en: The parameter set required for the moderation service, in JSON string format. Different service types correspond to different input fields: text detection uses content (String, the text content to be detected); image detection uses imageUrls (JSONArray, the list of image URLs to be detected); and file detection uses fileUrls (JSONArray, the list of file URLs to be detected)
parameters.help_zh: 审核服务需要的参数集，JSON 字符串格式。不同 Service 类型对应不同入参字段：文本检测使用 content（String，待检测的文本内容）；图片检测使用 imageUrls（JSONArray，待检测图片 URL 列表）；文件检测使用 fileUrls（JSONArray，待检测文件 URL 列表）
